The decisive mistake was in WebServing_Expert's step 2. The task needed the Dragon article's revision history around the leap days (29 February 2000 and 2004). Instead, the agent opened the current live Dragon article. It never opened the history or diff pages, such as `index.php?title=Dragon&action=history`, and never used the Wayback Machine. It then looped on the generic "Help:Page history" page and on search results, and never found the removed phrase "Here be dragons".

STEP: 2
